name: What information should I gather before planning a bathroom ventilation upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather before planning a bathroom ventilation upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting a ventilation upgrade estimate, measure your bathroom dimensions, note ceiling height, and inspect where your current fan appears to vent. Check whether your bathroom has an existing dedicated wall switch, a shared light-and-fan combo switch, or an accessible attic space above the ceiling. Knowing your finish preferences—such as integrated LED lighting, heating elements, or quiet continuous-run capabilities—helps your contractor provide an accurate scope of work and confirm electrical panel capacity during the project walk-through.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather room dimensions, ceiling heights, current switch configurations, attic accessibility, and preferences for built-in lights, quiet motors, or automated humidity sensors.
